# Capital Markets Academy

> UK forex and capital markets education academy, online and in London. Live coaching in technical analysis, news and fundamentals, and trading psychology, built on the Aulteus Logic EIT (Emotionally Intelligent Trader) framework created by founder Sam Onigbanjo. Educational content only; not financial advice.

## Key pages
- [Home and programmes](https://capitalmarketsacademy.com/): the EIT framework, programmes, pricing and FAQ
- [About Sam Onigbanjo](https://capitalmarketsacademy.com/about-us/): founder and creator of the EIT framework
- [Blog](https://capitalmarketsacademy.com/blog/): forex education and trading psychology
- [Contact](https://capitalmarketsacademy.com/contact/): enquiries and free introductory lesson

## Programmes
- The Market Recruit: beginner course, £397 one-time
- The Trading Desk: £97 per month; one 90-minute live session a month, Trading Library, AI assistant for analysis and trade reviews, training in news and fundamentals, technicals and emotional discipline
- The Inner Circle: live daily mentorship, by application
- Private 1-on-1 Coaching: one-to-one sessions, flexible

## Key terms
- EIT (Emotionally Intelligent Trader) framework: a six-protocol trading discipline system combining market intelligence, emotional intelligence and execution discipline.
- Traffic Light System: the first EIT protocol, a pre-trade check of the trader's emotional state (green, amber, red) before capital is at risk.

## Articles
- [The Traffic Light Check: the pre-trade question most traders never ask](https://capitalmarketsacademy.com/blog/traffic-light-check/): The EIT Traffic Light Check is a pre-trade test of your emotional state, not the market. Why it matters, when to run it, and what it protects.
- [Why the market does not beat most traders](https://capitalmarketsacademy.com/blog/why-the-market-does-not-beat-most-traders/): Most retail traders do not fail for lack of indicators. They fail from revenge trading, oversized risk and emotional decisions. How live coaching and accountability change that.
- [Why we train only on FCA-regulated platforms](https://capitalmarketsacademy.com/blog/fca-regulated-platforms/): Trading education is not regulated, but the platforms you trade on are. Why Capital Markets Academy trains only on FCA-regulated platforms, and how to check a firm yourself.
